generic.Defined scope/population: Bound policies released to issuance and awaiting the Issue job in Guidewire PolicyCenter.
generic.In-scope period: Policies bound in the current issuance day with effective dates on or after bind.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Effective date, expiration date, producer code and policy status populated on Policy Info.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of policies activated equals the count of bound policies released to the issuance queue.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issuance timestamp and issuing user retained on the PolicyCenter transaction history.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open issuance validation blockers logged on the work item with owner and disposition.
generic.Test population: All policies moved from Bound to In Force in PolicyCenter during the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every activated policy shows In Force with dates matching the bind order to the day.
generic.Exception handling path: Return the policy to the bound queue and refer the blocker to the Operations Specialist.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Status In Force plus effective and expiration dates equal to the bound quote.
generic.Evidence location: PolicyCenter policy transaction history and the daily in-force listing extract.

steps.title: Open the bound policy record in Guidewire PolicyCenter
sop: Search PolicyCenter by policy or submission number from the issuance work item.
Confirm the policy sits in Bound status and is assigned to this issuance queue.
Done when the bound policy is open on the Policy Info screen.
verify: Compare the policy number on screen with the issuance work item reference.
Pass when the open record is the bound policy named on the work item.

steps.title: Clear outstanding validation blockers on the PolicyCenter Issue screen
sop: Open the Issue screen and list every blocking validation message shown.
Resolve each blocker or refer it back to underwriting with a reason.
Done when the Issue screen shows no blocking validation messages.
verify: Re-run validation on the Issue screen after the fixes.
Pass when validation returns zero blocking errors for the policy.

steps.title: Run the Issue job in PolicyCenter to move status to In Force
sop: Start the Issue job from the bound policy transaction in PolicyCenter.
Commit the job and wait for the transaction to complete without error.
Done when the policy status reads In Force.
verify: Refresh the policy summary and read the status field.
Pass when status is In Force and no job error is displayed.

steps.title: Reconcile effective and expiration dates against the bind order
sop: Open the bind order alongside the PolicyCenter Policy Info screen.
Compare effective date and expiration date field by field to the day.
Done when both dates match the bind order exactly.
verify: Recheck the term length implied by the two dates against the bound quote.
Pass when both dates and the term length agree with the bind order.

steps.title: Confirm the policy appears on the in-force list for the producer and branch
sop: Run the in-force listing in PolicyCenter filtered on the policy producer code.
Confirm the policy shows under the correct producer code and branch.
Done when the policy is visible on the correct in-force listing.
verify: Check the branch and producer code shown on the listing row.
Pass when both match the producer record on the policy.

steps.title: Record the issuance timestamp and issuing user in transaction history
sop: Open the policy transaction history in PolicyCenter after the Issue job.
Confirm the Issue row carries the timestamp and the issuing user id.
Done when the issuance row is present with user and timestamp.
verify: Retrieve the Issue transaction row from the policy history screen.
Pass when the row shows a named issuing user and an issuance timestamp.

generic.Defined scope/population: Issuance documents eligible for electronic signature for this policy state and product.
generic.In-scope period: Documents sent for signature within the current issuance cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Signer name, signer email and document type populated on the DocuSign envelope.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Signed documents returned equals documents sent for signature on the envelope.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: DocuSign certificate of completion stored with the signed PDF in OpenText.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Declined or expired envelopes logged with the reason and the resend disposition.
generic.Test population: All issuance envelopes sent through DocuSign for the policy term under review.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every signed document has a completion certificate and no blank required tabs.
generic.Exception handling path: Void the envelope and route wet-signature-required documents to the paper path.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: E-signature permitted for the state and document type and all tags completed.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText Document Mgmt policy folder and the DocuSign envelope history.

steps.title: Confirm state and product permit e-signature for the document type
sop: Check the e-signature permission matrix for the risk state and product.
Identify any document in the set that requires a wet signature.
Done when each document is classified as e-sign permitted or wet-signature only.
verify: Re-read the matrix entry for the risk state and document type.
Pass when every document routed to DocuSign is e-sign permitted.

steps.title: Build the issuance envelope in DocuSign from the approved template
sop: Select the approved issuance envelope template in DocuSign.
Attach the declarations and required notices to the envelope.
Done when the envelope contains the full signature-required document set.
verify: Compare the envelope document list against the issuance document checklist.
Pass when every signature-required document is on the envelope.

steps.title: Validate the signer email against the policy record
sop: Read the named insured or authorised officer contact on the policy record.
Compare the DocuSign recipient email to that contact record.
Done when the signer email matches the policy record contact.
verify: Recheck the recipient block on the envelope before send.
Pass when the recipient is the named insured or an authorised officer.

steps.title: Send the envelope and monitor signature completion in DocuSign
sop: Send the envelope and record the envelope id on the issuance work item.
Monitor envelope status and chase the signer before expiry.
Done when the envelope status reads Completed.
verify: Open the envelope status page in DocuSign.
Pass when status is Completed with no outstanding recipient.

steps.title: Check every required signature and initial tab is completed
sop: Download the completed PDF from DocuSign.
Inspect each signature and initial tag for a captured mark.
Done when no required tab is left blank on the downloaded document.
verify: Re-scan the document for empty signature or initial fields.
Pass when zero required tabs are blank.

steps.title: File the signed document and completion certificate in OpenText
sop: Upload the signed PDF to the policy folder in OpenText Document Mgmt.
Attach the DocuSign certificate of completion to the same document record.
Done when signed document and certificate are stored together.
verify: Retrieve the document from OpenText and open its attachments.
Pass when the certificate of completion is present with the signed document.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every rated coverage on the policy plus taxes, fees and surcharges from the rating worksheet.
generic.In-scope period: The policy term being issued, using the rate book effective at the effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Premium by coverage, rate book version, taxes, fees and pay plan populated on the premium screen.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total written premium on the declarations equals the rating engine total to the cent.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rating worksheet version and applied rate revision retained on the policy file.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Manual premium overrides logged with the approving authority and the reason.
generic.Test population: All coverages priced on the policy being issued.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero cent variance between the policy premium screen and the rating engine output.
generic.Exception handling path: Return the policy to rating and refer the variance to the Underwriting Assistant.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Filed rate book applied and premium reconciled by coverage with fees itemised.
generic.Evidence location: Policy premium screen in the policy administration system and the rating worksheet.

steps.title: Retrieve the final rating worksheet from the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the bound submission on the underwriting workstation.
Download the final rating worksheet showing premium by coverage.
Done when the final rating worksheet is available for entry.
verify: Check the worksheet is the final version tied to the bound quote.
Pass when the worksheet reference matches the bound quote number.

steps.title: Confirm the rate book version applied is filed for the policy state
sop: Read the rate revision or rate book version on the rating worksheet.
Confirm that version is filed and effective for the state at the effective date.
Done when the applied rate book is confirmed as filed and effective.
verify: Recheck the filing effective date against the policy effective date.
Pass when the rate book is effective on the policy effective date.

steps.title: Enter premium by coverage on the policy premium screen
sop: Open the premium screen on the policy administration system.
Enter or accept the rated premium for each coverage from the worksheet.
Done when every coverage carries its rated premium.
verify: Compare each coverage line on screen to the worksheet line.
Pass when every coverage premium matches the worksheet.

steps.title: Itemise taxes, surcharges and fees separately from base premium
sop: Enter taxes, surcharges and fees on their own premium lines.
Confirm none of these amounts are folded into the base premium.
Done when taxes, surcharges and fees appear as separate lines.
verify: Read the premium breakdown on the declarations preview.
Pass when base premium and each charge type are shown separately.

steps.title: Reconcile the declarations total to the rating engine total
sop: Sum the policy premium screen total including taxes and fees.
Compare it to the rating engine total written premium.
Done when the two totals agree to the cent.
verify: Recompute the difference between the two totals.
Pass when the difference is zero.

steps.title: Confirm the instalment schedule reflects the rated premium and pay plan
sop: Open the pay plan and instalment schedule on the policy.
Confirm the instalments sum to the rated annual premium plus charges.
Done when the schedule reconciles to the rated premium.
verify: Total the scheduled instalments and compare to the policy premium.
Pass when the instalment total equals the premium billed.

generic.Defined scope/population: All forms on the policy forms schedule plus the mandatory notice set for the risk state.
generic.In-scope period: The policy term being issued using form editions effective at the effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Named insured, address, limits, deductibles and premium correct on the declarations page.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Form count and page count in the PDF match the composition manifest.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assembled package stored in OpenText with its composition manifest and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing or superseded forms logged as defects with the correction disposition.
generic.Test population: Every form listed on the policy forms schedule for the issued term.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero missing forms and zero superseded editions in the assembled package.
generic.Exception handling path: Return the package to composition and re-assemble before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Package ordered declarations, forms, endorsements, notices with all forms present.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText Document Mgmt policy folder and the policy forms schedule.

steps.title: Pull the policy forms schedule from the policy administration system
sop: Open the issued policy and export the forms schedule with editions.
Save the schedule as the assembly reference list.
Done when the forms schedule is available for tick-off.
verify: Check the schedule belongs to the term being issued.
Pass when the schedule term dates match the policy term.

steps.title: Assemble the package in the required document order
sop: Place the declarations page first, then coverage forms, then endorsements.
Append the mandatory state notices at the end of the package.
Done when the package follows the required document order.
verify: Read the package bookmarks in sequence.
Pass when the order is declarations, forms, endorsements, notices.

steps.title: Tick each form number on the schedule against the assembled PDF
sop: Work down the forms schedule and locate each form in the PDF.
Mark any form listed but absent as a defect.
Done when every scheduled form is ticked as present.
verify: Count the ticked forms against the schedule line count.
Pass when the two counts are equal.

steps.title: Confirm the state mandatory notice set for the risk state is included
sop: List the mandatory notices for the risk state including privacy and fraud warning.
Confirm each required notice is in the package and OFAC where applicable.
Done when every mandatory notice is present.
verify: Recheck the notice list against the package contents.
Pass when no mandatory notice for the state is missing.

steps.title: Check declarations data against the policy record
sop: Compare named insured, mailing address, limits and deductibles to the policy record.
Compare the declarations premium to the policy premium screen.
Done when all declarations values match the policy record.
verify: Re-read each compared field on the declarations page.
Pass when no declarations field differs from the policy record.

steps.title: Reconcile page count and bookmarks to the composition manifest in OpenText
sop: Open the composition manifest for the generated set.
Compare total page count and bookmark list to the assembled PDF.
Done when page count and bookmarks agree with the manifest.
verify: Recount pages and bookmarks in the stored package.
Pass when both match the manifest before release.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policies awaiting a policy number at issuance in the policy administration system.
generic.In-scope period: Numbers assigned during the current issuance run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Line-of-business prefix, state prefix and sequence number populated on the policy record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Policy numbers assigned equals policies issued in the run with no gaps or reuse.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Number assignment recorded on the policy record with the assigning user and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Manual number requests logged with the reason and the approving disposition.
generic.Test population: All policy numbers generated in the issuance run under review.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero duplicate policy numbers across active policies.
generic.Exception handling path: Void the number, regenerate from sequence and refer the duplicate to the Processing Clerk.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Number generated from system sequence, correctly prefixed and linked to the submission.
generic.Evidence location: Policy record header in PolicyCenter and the policy number sequence log.

steps.title: Generate the policy number from the PolicyCenter sequence
sop: Trigger number assignment from the issuance transaction in PolicyCenter.
Do not key a number manually into the policy number field.
Done when the system has generated the policy number.
verify: Check the assignment source recorded against the number.
Pass when the number came from the system sequence.

steps.title: Confirm the line-of-business and state prefix on the number
sop: Read the prefix segments of the generated number.
Compare them to the product line and risk state on the policy.
Done when both prefix segments match the product and state.
verify: Re-read the prefix against the numbering standard.
Pass when the prefix matches the product and risk state.

steps.title: Check the number is not already assigned to another risk
sop: Search PolicyCenter for the assigned number across all statuses.
Confirm no other active or cancelled submission holds the number.
Done when the search returns only this policy.
verify: Re-run the search including cancelled and expired records.
Pass when only the current policy is returned.

steps.title: Link the policy number to the submission and quote number
sop: Open the policy record and confirm the originating submission reference.
Record the quote number against the issued policy number.
Done when submission and quote references are linked to the number.
verify: Navigate from the policy number to the originating submission.
Pass when the submission and quote both resolve from the policy.

steps.title: Confirm the declarations shows the assigned policy number
sop: Open the generated declarations page for the policy.
Compare the printed policy number to the system record.
Done when the printed number matches the system record.
verify: Re-read the number on the declarations header.
Pass when printed and system numbers are identical.

steps.title: Record the assignment on the policy record for audit
sop: Confirm the assignment wrote a history row with user and timestamp.
Note the number on the issuance work item.
Done when the assignment is recorded in policy history.
verify: Open the policy history and locate the assignment row.
Pass when the row shows the assigning user and timestamp.

generic.Defined scope/population: Issuance work items whose policy has been issued and documents delivered.
generic.In-scope period: Work items completed within the current issuance SLA window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Closure reason code, completion date and attached documents populated on the work item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Work items closed equals policies issued for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued policy documents attached to the work item with the closure timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open pended items or missing-document flags logged with disposition before closure.
generic.Test population: All issuance work items closed in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No work item closed with an open required-document subtask.
generic.Exception handling path: Reopen the work item and return it to the issuance queue with the open subtask named.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reason Issued Complete recorded with issued documents attached and SLA date captured.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow case management tool work item record and its attachment list.

steps.title: Review every subtask on the issuance work item in the case tool
sop: Open the issuance work item in the workflow case management tool.
List every subtask and its current status.
Done when each subtask status has been reviewed.
verify: Recount subtasks not in Complete status.
Pass when zero subtasks remain incomplete.

steps.title: Attach the issued policy documents as the closing artefact
sop: Retrieve the issued policy package from the policy record.
Attach it to the work item as the closing artefact.
Done when the issued package is attached to the work item.
verify: Open the work item attachment list.
Pass when the issued policy package is present.

steps.title: Record the issuance completion date against the SLA clock
sop: Read the SLA clock start date recorded at bind.
Enter the issuance completion date on the work item.
Done when the completion date is recorded against the SLA.
verify: Recompute elapsed days from bind to completion.
Pass when the elapsed days are recorded on the work item.

steps.title: Set the closure reason code to Issued Complete
sop: Open the closure panel on the work item.
Select Issued Complete rather than a cancel or withdraw code.
Done when the closure reason reads Issued Complete.
verify: Re-read the closure reason on the work item.
Pass when the reason is Issued Complete.

steps.title: Confirm no pended item or missing-document flag remains on the queue
sop: Filter the issuance queue on this policy number.
Confirm no pended item or missing-document flag is outstanding.
Done when the queue shows no open flag for the policy.
verify: Re-run the queue filter after closure.
Pass when the policy returns no open queue items.

steps.title: Close the work item and confirm the closed status
sop: Submit the closure on the work item in the case tool.
Confirm the status changes to Closed with the reason retained.
Done when the work item status reads Closed.
verify: Reopen the work item record read-only.
Pass when status is Closed with reason and artefacts retained.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policy packages despatched to insureds and producers awaiting delivery acknowledgment.
generic.In-scope period: Despatches within the current follow-up window from the send date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Acknowledgment date, delivery channel and recipient recorded on the delivery record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Acknowledgments logged plus open chases equals packages despatched.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Delivery receipt or tracking confirmation stored with its date against the policy.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Bounced or undeliverable addresses logged with the producer referral disposition.
generic.Test population: All policy packages despatched in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No delivery left unresolved past the standard follow-up window.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate undeliverable addresses to the producer and record the corrected address.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Acknowledgment date and channel recorded against the policy delivery record.
generic.Evidence location: Policy delivery record in the administration system and CRM contact history.

steps.title: Pull the despatch log for the policy package
sop: Open the policy delivery record in the administration system.
List the despatch date, channel and recipients for the package.
Done when the despatch details are on hand.
verify: Confirm the despatch entry matches the issued policy term.
Pass when the despatch row belongs to the current term.

steps.title: Check the email or portal read receipt against the send log
sop: Open the delivery receipt in the CRM for the electronic despatch.
Match the receipt to the send log entry for the package.
Done when the receipt is matched to the despatch.
verify: Compare receipt timestamp to the send timestamp.
Pass when the receipt corresponds to the logged despatch.

steps.title: Record the certified or tracked mail number for postal despatches
sop: Retrieve the tracking or certified mail number for the postal package.
Record the number and the delivery date on the delivery record.
Done when tracking number and delivery date are recorded.
verify: Re-read the tracking fields on the delivery record.
Pass when tracking number and delivery date are both present.

steps.title: Log the acknowledgment date on the policy delivery record
sop: Enter the acknowledgment date and channel on the policy delivery record.
Attach the receipt evidence to the same record.
Done when the acknowledgment is logged with evidence.
verify: Open the delivery record and read the acknowledgment fields.
Pass when date, channel and evidence are all recorded.

steps.title: Chase packages with no acknowledgment after the follow-up window
sop: List packages past the follow-up window with no acknowledgment.
Contact the recipient and record the chase on the CRM contact history.
Done when each overdue package has a logged chase.
verify: Re-run the overdue list after the chases.
Pass when every overdue package shows a logged chase.

steps.title: Escalate undeliverable addresses to the producer and record the outcome
sop: Identify bounced or returned deliveries on the log.
Refer the address to the producer and capture the corrected address.
Done when each undeliverable has a recorded outcome.
verify: Re-check the undeliverable list for open items.
Pass when no undeliverable is left without a recorded outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every form and endorsement edition planned for issue in the risk state.
generic.In-scope period: Filing status as at the policy effective date being issued.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Form number, edition date, state and filing reference captured on the issuance checklist.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Forms checked equals forms on the policy forms schedule.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Filing reference and edition date retained against each form on the checklist.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Forms with pending or withdrawn filings logged and referred to product compliance.
generic.Test population: All forms on the issued policy forms schedule for the risk state.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every issued form carries an approved filing valid at the effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Hold issuance and refer the form to product compliance for substitution.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Filing status Approved or Filed and Effective at the policy effective date.
generic.Evidence location: State filing register entries and the issuance checklist on the policy file.

steps.title: List the forms and editions from the policy forms schedule
sop: Open the policy forms schedule in the policy administration system.
Record each form number with its edition date for checking.
Done when the full form and edition list is captured.
verify: Compare the captured list to the schedule line count.
Pass when every scheduled form appears on the list.

steps.title: Look up each form on the state filing register
sop: Search the filing register for the risk state by form number and edition.
Read the filing status returned for each form.
Done when every form has a filing status recorded.
verify: Recheck that a status was returned for every listed form.
Pass when no form is left without a filing status.

steps.title: Confirm filing status is valid at the policy effective date
sop: Compare the filing effective date to the policy effective date.
Confirm the status is Approved or Filed and Effective at that date.
Done when each form is confirmed valid on the effective date.
verify: Re-read the filing effective and withdrawal dates.
Pass when no form is pending or withdrawn at the effective date.

steps.title: Check state-specific amendatory endorsements are on the package
sop: Identify the amendatory endorsements required in the risk state.
Confirm each required endorsement is on the forms schedule.
Done when all required amendatory endorsements are present.
verify: Recheck the schedule for the required endorsement numbers.
Pass when no required amendatory endorsement is missing.

steps.title: Record the filing reference against each form on the checklist
sop: Enter the filing reference number beside each form on the issuance checklist.
Save the checklist to the policy file.
Done when every form carries a filing reference on the checklist.
verify: Read the checklist for blank reference fields.
Pass when no form is left without a filing reference.

steps.title: Refer expired or pending filings to product compliance
sop: List forms whose filing is expired, pending or withdrawn.
Refer each to product compliance and hold issuance for those forms.
Done when every problem form has a compliance referral logged.
verify: Re-check the referral log against the problem form list.
Pass when no problem form is left unreferred.

generic.Defined scope/population: Issued policy packages for despatch to the insured and the producer of record.
generic.In-scope period: Packages despatched within the delivery standard after issuance.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Delivery preference, recipient address and consent flag populated on the policy record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Despatch log entries equal two per policy, one insured copy and one producer copy.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Despatch date, channel and recipient retained on the policy delivery log.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing electronic consent logged and the package rerouted to paper.
generic.Test population: All policy packages despatched in the issuance period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No electronic-only delivery without recorded electronic consent.
generic.Exception handling path: Hold electronic despatch and route to postal delivery until consent is captured.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Despatch recorded with channel, recipient and date for insured and producer.
generic.Evidence location: Policy delivery log in the administration system and CRM despatch history.

steps.title: Read the delivery preference flag on the policy record
sop: Open the policy record and read the delivery preference of paper, email or portal.
Note the preference on the despatch worksheet.
Done when the delivery channel is determined for the policy.
verify: Re-read the preference field on the policy record.
Pass when the chosen channel matches the recorded preference.

steps.title: Confirm electronic delivery consent before any electronic despatch
sop: Check the electronic consent flag and consent date on the policy record.
Reroute to paper where consent is absent or withdrawn.
Done when consent status is confirmed for the chosen channel.
verify: Re-read the consent flag before releasing the despatch.
Pass when electronic despatch only occurs with consent on file.

steps.title: Confirm the despatch address matches the declarations mailing address
sop: Compare the despatch address to the mailing address on the declarations.
Correct the despatch address where it differs from the policy record.
Done when despatch address and declarations address agree.
verify: Re-read both addresses side by side.
Pass when the two addresses are identical.

steps.title: Despatch the insured copy from OpenText on the preferred channel
sop: Retrieve the issued package from OpenText Document Mgmt.
Despatch the insured copy on the recorded delivery channel.
Done when the insured copy has been despatched.
verify: Check the despatch confirmation for the insured copy.
Pass when a despatch confirmation exists for the insured.

steps.title: Send the producer copy to the agency of record address
sop: Read the agency of record address from the producer record in the CRM.
Despatch the producer copy to that agency address only.
Done when the producer copy is despatched to the agency address.
verify: Compare the despatch address to the producer record address.
Pass when the producer copy went to the agency of record address.

steps.title: Record despatch date, channel and recipient on the delivery log
sop: Enter despatch date, channel and recipient for both copies on the delivery log.
Attach the despatch confirmations to the policy record.
Done when both despatches are logged with evidence.
verify: Read the delivery log rows for this policy.
Pass when insured and producer despatches are both logged.

generic.Defined scope/population: Delivery receipts, tracking confirmations and portal acknowledgments for issued policy terms.
generic.In-scope period: Proofs received for policies issued in the current term period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Recipient, address and delivery date visible on the proof and in its index values.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Proofs filed equals policy terms issued and despatched in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Proof stored under the policy-file retention class with its capture timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Terms without a proof logged and chased with the correspondence team.
generic.Test population: All issued policy terms despatched during the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No issued term left without a proof-of-delivery artefact on file.
generic.Exception handling path: Raise a missing-proof item to the Correspondence Clerk and hold closure of the term file.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Proof indexed as Proof of Delivery against the policy number and term.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText Document Mgmt policy folder linked to the issuance transaction.

steps.title: Collect the delivery proof artefact for the despatched package
sop: Gather the delivery receipt, tracking confirmation or portal acknowledgment.
Confirm the artefact relates to the issued policy package.
Done when the proof artefact is in hand for the policy.
verify: Match the artefact reference to the despatch log entry.
Pass when the artefact matches the logged despatch.

steps.title: Confirm the proof shows recipient, address and delivery date
sop: Open the artefact and read the recipient, address and delivery date.
Reject artefacts that do not evidence delivery on their face.
Done when all three details are legible on the proof.
verify: Re-read the three fields on the proof.
Pass when recipient, address and date are all present.

steps.title: Index the proof in OpenText under document type Proof of Delivery
sop: Upload the artefact to the policy folder in OpenText Document Mgmt.
Set document type to Proof of Delivery with the policy number and term.
Done when the proof is indexed under the correct type and term.
verify: Search OpenText by policy number and document type.
Pass when the proof is returned for the correct term.

steps.title: Apply the policy-file retention class to the stored proof
sop: Set the retention class to the statutory policy-file class.
Confirm the calculated destruction date is not earlier than the statutory period.
Done when the retention class is applied to the proof.
verify: Re-read the retention class and destruction date on the record.
Pass when retention meets the statutory period for the policy.

steps.title: Link the proof to the issuance transaction in the policy record
sop: Open the issuance transaction in the policy administration system.
Attach or link the stored proof so it surfaces in the policy document list.
Done when the proof appears on the policy document list.
verify: Open the policy document list for the term.
Pass when the proof is visible from the policy record.

steps.title: Reconcile proofs filed against terms despatched for the period
sop: List issued terms despatched in the period from the delivery log.
Compare that list to proofs indexed in OpenText.
Done when every despatched term is matched to a proof or an open chase.
verify: Recount unmatched terms after the chases are raised.
Pass when every despatched term has a proof or a logged chase.

generic.Defined scope/population: Document set generated by the composition engine for the issued policy transaction.
generic.In-scope period: Documents composed for the policy term being issued.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Insured name, address, limits, deductible and premium merged without placeholders.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documents written back to the policy list equals documents in the composition manifest.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Template version and composition run timestamp retained with the generated set.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Composition warnings and missing-variable errors logged with the rerun disposition.
generic.Test population: All documents produced by the composition run for this policy.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero unresolved merge placeholders across the generated set.
generic.Exception handling path: Fix the source data and rerun composition rather than editing the PDF.

generic.Evidence location: Policy document list in the administration system and OpenText Document Mgmt.

steps.title: Trigger composition from the issued policy transaction

Start the document composition job from that transaction.

verify: Check the job source recorded on the composition run.

steps.title: Confirm the engine selected the current template version

Compare it to the current approved version for product and state.
Done when the run used the current template version.
verify: Re-read the template version on the run log.
Pass when the version matches the current approved template.

steps.title: Spot-check merge fields on the generated declarations
sop: Open the generated PDF and read insured name, address and limits.
Compare deductible and premium to the policy record.
Done when the sampled merge fields match the policy record.
verify: Recheck each sampled field against the policy screen.
Pass when no sampled merge field differs from the record.

steps.title: Review the composition log for warnings and missing variables
sop: Open the composition run log and list warnings and errors.
Resolve the underlying data issue for each warning raised.
Done when the run log shows no unresolved warnings.
verify: Rerun composition after fixes and reread the log.
Pass when the final run log contains no warnings.

steps.title: Scan the generated set for unresolved placeholders
sop: Search the generated PDFs for placeholder markers and empty merge tokens.
Report any document containing a placeholder for rerun.
Done when no document in the set contains a placeholder.
verify: Repeat the placeholder search on the final set.
Pass when the search returns zero placeholder occurrences.

steps.title: Confirm the set is written back with correct document types
sop: Open the policy document list after the run completes.
Confirm each generated document carries its correct document type.
Done when the full set is listed with correct types.
verify: Compare the document list to the composition manifest.
Pass when every manifest document is present with the right type.

generic.Defined scope/population: Issuance transactions posted on the policy for the term being issued.
generic.In-scope period: Issuance events recorded in the current processing day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: User, timestamp, transaction type Issue, quote reference and premium populated on the entry.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Audit entries recorded equals issuance transactions posted for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Immutable audit row retained on the policy history with user and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Manual overrides named on the audit entry with the approver and disposition.
generic.Test population: All issuance transactions posted in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No issuance transaction recorded without an identified performing user.
generic.Exception handling path: Raise a data incident where an audit row is missing and reconstruct from system logs.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Audit entry present with user, timestamp, transaction type and issued premium.
generic.Evidence location: Policy history screen in the administration system and the workflow case record.

steps.title: Open the policy history after the issuance transaction posts
sop: Open the policy in the administration system and select policy history.
Locate the transaction row for the issuance event.
Done when the issuance row is visible in policy history.
verify: Match the row transaction date to the issuance date.
Pass when the issuance row exists for the correct date.

steps.title: Confirm the audit row carries user, timestamp and type Issue
sop: Read the user, timestamp and transaction type on the audit row.
Confirm the type is Issue and not a correction code.
Done when all three attributes are confirmed on the row.
verify: Re-read the three attributes on the audit row.
Pass when user, timestamp and type Issue are all present.

steps.title: Check the entry captures the bound quote reference and premium
sop: Read the quote reference and issued premium recorded on the entry.
Compare them to the bound quote and the policy premium screen.
Done when quote reference and premium are captured correctly.
verify: Recompare the entry values to the bound quote.
Pass when both values agree with the bound quote.

steps.title: Name any manual override and its approver on the audit entry
sop: List manual overrides applied during issuance.
Confirm each override and its approver is named on the audit entry.
Done when every override is named with its approver.
verify: Recheck the entry against the override list.
Pass when no override is missing an approver reference.

steps.title: Confirm the audit entry is immutable to servicing users
sop: Open the audit entry as a servicing user in the case tool and policy history.
Confirm no edit or delete control is exposed.
Done when the entry offers no edit or delete option.
verify: Attempt to open the entry for edit as a servicing user.
Pass when the system offers no edit or delete path.

steps.title: Spot-check retrieval of the entry from the policy history screen
sop: Navigate to the policy history screen for the issued term.
Retrieve the issuance audit entry from that screen.
Done when the entry is retrievable for the term.
verify: Repeat the retrieval on a second sampled policy.
Pass when the entry is retrievable on every sampled policy.

generic.Defined scope/population: New Business Issue transactions to be posted to the policy ledger at issuance.
generic.In-scope period: The accounting period matching the policy effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Transaction type, effective date, written premium and producer code populated on the ledger row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Written premium posted equals the premium on the issued declarations.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Ledger row retained with posting timestamp and accounting period stamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Transactions in error status on the interface monitor logged with the rework disposition.
generic.Test population: All issuance transactions posted to the ledger in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No issuance transaction left in error status on the interface queue.
generic.Exception handling path: Reprocess the failed transaction from the interface monitor and record the outcome.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: New Business Issue posted for the correct period with the commission-driving producer code.
generic.Evidence location: Policy transaction ledger in PolicyCenter and the interface monitor log.

steps.title: Post the issuance transaction to the policy ledger in PolicyCenter
sop: Complete the issuance transaction so it writes to the policy ledger.
Confirm the transaction effective date equals the policy effective date.
Done when the transaction appears on the policy ledger.
verify: Open the ledger and locate the posted transaction.
Pass when the ledger row exists with the correct effective date.

steps.title: Confirm the transaction type is New Business Issue
sop: Read the transaction type code on the ledger row.
Confirm it is New Business Issue and not a correction or rewrite.
Done when the type reads New Business Issue.
verify: Re-read the transaction type on the ledger.
Pass when the type is New Business Issue.

steps.title: Check the written premium posted to the correct accounting period
sop: Read the accounting period stamped on the posted transaction.
Compare it to the period implied by the effective date.
Done when the posting period matches the effective date period.
verify: Recheck the period stamp against the effective date.
Pass when the two periods agree.

steps.title: Verify the producer code that will drive commission
sop: Read the producer code carried on the ledger transaction.
Compare it to the producer of record on the policy.
Done when the producer code matches the policy producer.
verify: Re-read the producer code on the transaction.
Pass when it equals the policy producer of record.

steps.title: Review the interface monitor for pending or errored status
sop: Open the interface monitor and filter on the policy number.
Confirm the issuance message shows no pending or errored status.
Done when the interface shows the message as processed.
verify: Refresh the monitor after the next interface run.
Pass when the transaction shows no error or pending state.

steps.title: Reconcile posted written premium to the issued declarations
sop: Total the written premium posted on the ledger for the transaction.
Compare it to the premium shown on the issued declarations.
Done when the two amounts agree to the cent.
verify: Recompute the difference between ledger and declarations premium.
Pass when the difference is zero.

generic.Defined scope/population: Assembled policy packages awaiting quality review before release to the insured.
generic.In-scope period: Packages reviewed in the current issuance day before despatch.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Limits, deductibles, forms and effective dates present on the declarations for comparison.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Packages reviewed equals packages queued for release in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Quality review result and reviewer name retained on the issuance checklist.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Discrepancies logged with a defect code and returned to issuance for correction.
generic.Test population: All policy packages presented for quality review in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No package released to the insured with an open quality defect.
generic.Exception handling path: Return the package to issuance under a defect code rather than correcting silently.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Declarations match the bind authority letter and all state notices are present.
generic.Evidence location: Issuance checklist on the policy file and the package stored in OpenText.

steps.title: Retrieve the bind authority letter and the assembled package
sop: Open the bind authority letter on the underwriting workstation.
Open the assembled package from OpenText Document Mgmt.
Done when both documents are open for comparison.
verify: Confirm both documents relate to the same policy and term.
Pass when policy number and term agree across both.

steps.title: Compare limits, deductibles, forms and dates to the bind authority
sop: Compare each limit and deductible on the declarations to the bind letter.
Compare forms listed and effective dates to the bind letter.
Done when every compared item has been checked.
verify: Re-read any item marked as differing.
Pass when no compared item differs from the bind authority.

steps.title: Confirm the binding underwriter held authority for premium and limit
sop: Look up the binding underwriter in the authority matrix.
Confirm the matrix covers the issued premium and limit.
Done when the underwriter authority is confirmed for the risk.
verify: Recheck the matrix row against the issued premium and limit.
Pass when the bind falls inside the underwriter authority.

steps.title: Check every mandatory state notice is present in the package
sop: List the mandatory notices for the risk state.
Confirm each notice is present in the assembled package.
Done when all mandatory notices are confirmed present.
verify: Re-check the notice list against the package contents.
Pass when no mandatory notice is missing.

steps.title: Record the review result and reviewer name on the issuance checklist
sop: Enter the review outcome on the issuance checklist.
Record the reviewer name and review date.
Done when outcome, reviewer and date are recorded.
verify: Re-read the checklist review section.
Pass when the outcome carries a named reviewer and a date.

steps.title: Return defective packages to issuance with a defect code
sop: Raise a defect code for each discrepancy found.
Return the package to the issuance queue rather than editing it.
Done when every discrepancy has a raised defect and return.
verify: Check the release queue for packages with open defects.
Pass when no package with an open defect sits in the release queue.

generic.Defined scope/population: Bound risk packages handed from underwriting to issuance for the current queue.
generic.In-scope period: Packages received in the current business day of issuance intake.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Bind order, signed application, rating worksheet and bind approval date present on the package.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Packages acknowledged equals packages released by underwriting for the day.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Receipt acknowledgment retained with timestamp on the issuance work item.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing bind artefacts logged with a reason code and rejected back to underwriting.
generic.Test population: All bound risk packages received into issuance in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No issuance started against a package lacking a dated underwriter bind approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Reject the package to underwriting with the reason code and hold the SLA clock.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Bind order, signed application and rating worksheet all present and dated correctly.
generic.Evidence location: Issuance work item in the workflow case tool with the attached bind artefacts.

steps.title: Open the bound risk package on the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the released submission on the underwriting workstation.
List the artefacts attached to the bound risk package.
Done when the package contents are listed for checking.
verify: Match the submission number to the issuance queue entry.
Pass when the package matches the queued submission.

steps.title: Confirm bind order, signed application and rating worksheet are present
sop: Check the package for the bind order document.
Check for the signed application and the final rating worksheet.
Done when all three mandatory artefacts are confirmed present.
verify: Re-check the artefact list for the three mandatory documents.
Pass when none of the three is missing.

steps.title: Check the bind approval is dated on or before the effective date
sop: Read the underwriter bind approval and its date.
Compare that date to the requested effective date.
Done when the approval date is on or before the effective date.
verify: Re-read approval date and effective date.
Pass when the approval is not later than the effective date.

steps.title: Record bind subjectivities as open items with due dates
sop: List the subjectivities stated on the bind order.
Create an open item with a due date for each subjectivity on the policy.
Done when every subjectivity exists as a dated open item.
verify: Compare open items on the policy to the bind order list.
Pass when every subjectivity has a matching open item.

steps.title: Acknowledge receipt and start the issuance SLA clock
sop: Acknowledge receipt to underwriting on the workflow case tool.
Start the issuance SLA clock on the work item.
Done when receipt is acknowledged and the SLA clock is running.
verify: Read the SLA start timestamp on the work item.
Pass when the SLA clock start is recorded.

steps.title: Reject incomplete packages back to underwriting with a reason code
sop: Raise a rejection with the reason code naming the missing artefact.
Return the package to underwriting and pause issuance.
Done when the incomplete package is rejected with a reason.
verify: Check the issuance queue for packages missing mandatory artefacts.
Pass when no such package remains in the active issuance queue.

generic.Defined scope/population: Approved forms and endorsements applicable to the product, state and effective date.
generic.In-scope period: Form editions approved and effective at the policy effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Form number, edition date and attachment reason populated on the forms schedule.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Forms on the saved schedule equals bound forms plus mandatory auto-attaching forms.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Forms schedule saved to the policy with each form edition date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Forms sourced outside the approved library logged and replaced from the library.
generic.Test population: All forms retrieved for the policy being issued.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero forms retrieved from outside the approved forms library.
generic.Exception handling path: Discard the non-library copy and re-pull the form from the approved library.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Schedule lists each form number and edition and prints on the declarations.
generic.Evidence location: Policy forms schedule in the administration system and the approved forms library.

steps.title: Open the approved forms library for the product and state
sop: Open the approved forms library in the policy administration system.
Filter on product, risk state and policy effective date.
Done when the library is filtered to the applicable form set.
verify: Recheck the filter values against the policy record.
Pass when product, state and date filters match the policy.

steps.title: Pull each applicable form from the library rather than a local copy
sop: Select each applicable form directly from the library results.
Do not attach any saved local or emailed copy of a form.
Done when every form has been pulled from the library.
verify: Check the source recorded against each attached form.
Pass when every form shows the approved library as its source.

steps.title: Confirm each form edition is currently approved for the risk state
sop: Read the edition date on each selected form.
Confirm the edition is the current approved edition for the state.
Done when every edition is confirmed current.
verify: Re-read edition dates against the library current edition.
Pass when no superseded edition remains selected.

steps.title: Add bound endorsements and remove any not bound
sop: Read the endorsement list from the bind order.
Add each bound endorsement and remove endorsements not bound.
Done when the schedule matches the bind order endorsements.
verify: Compare the schedule endorsements to the bind order list.
Pass when the two lists agree exactly.

steps.title: Check mandatory auto-attaching forms were added by the forms engine
sop: Run the forms engine and read the auto-attached mandatory forms.
Confirm none of the mandatory forms was dropped.
Done when all mandatory auto-attaching forms are present.
verify: Recheck mandatory forms for the state against the schedule.
Pass when no mandatory auto-attaching form is missing.

steps.title: Save the forms schedule so it prints on the declarations
sop: Save the resulting forms schedule to the policy record.
Preview the declarations to confirm the schedule prints.
Done when the schedule is saved and prints on the declarations.
verify: Read the printed forms schedule on the declarations preview.
Pass when every scheduled form number and edition prints.

generic.Defined scope/population: Issued policies eligible for the producer compensation extract in this feed run.
generic.In-scope period: Policies issued since the previous compensation feed run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, producer code, written premium and commission rate present on each record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Records sent equals records received on the commission platform interface log.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Feed run timestamp recorded on the policy transaction for payment traceability.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected compensation records logged with the reprocessing disposition and outcome.
generic.Test population: All compensation records transmitted in the feed run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No rejected compensation record left unreprocessed after the run.
generic.Exception handling path: Correct the source data and resend the rejected record on the next feed cycle.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Feed accepted by the commission platform with counts reconciled both sides.
generic.Evidence location: Commission platform interface log and the policy transaction feed timestamp.

steps.title: Trigger the compensation extract for issued policies
sop: Run the compensation extract in the billing/commission platform for the period.
Confirm the extract includes the newly issued policies.
Done when the extract has been generated for the run.
verify: Read the extract header count and period.
Pass when the extract covers the intended issuance period.

steps.title: Check each record carries policy, producer, premium and rate
sop: Open the extract file and inspect the record layout.
Confirm policy number, producer code, written premium and rate are populated.
Done when all four fields are populated on every record.
verify: Scan the extract for null values in the four fields.
Pass when no record has a blank mandatory field.

steps.title: Transmit the feed to the commission platform
sop: Transmit the extract to the commission platform on the agreed channel.
Confirm the platform acknowledges receipt of the file.
Done when the file is acknowledged as received.
verify: Read the transmission acknowledgment on the interface log.
Pass when the platform acknowledges the file.

steps.title: Reconcile record counts sent against records received
sop: Read the sent count from the extract and the received count from the log.
Investigate any difference between the two counts.
Done when sent and received counts agree.
verify: Recompute the count difference on the interface log.
Pass when the difference is zero.

steps.title: Reprocess records rejected by the compensation platform
sop: List records rejected by the commission platform with their reasons.
Correct the source data and resubmit each rejected record.
Done when every rejected record has been resubmitted or dispositioned.
verify: Re-read the rejection queue after resubmission.
Pass when no rejected record remains unresolved.

steps.title: Record the feed run timestamp on the policy transaction
sop: Open the issuance transaction in the policy administration system.
Record the compensation feed run timestamp against it.
Done when the feed timestamp is stored on the transaction.
verify: Re-read the feed timestamp on the policy transaction.
Pass when the timestamp is present and matches the run.

generic.Defined scope/population: Producers due commission on policies issued and released for calculation.
generic.In-scope period: The commission cycle in which the issuance falls.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Producer licence, appointment status, commission schedule and split percentages populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Split commission percentages across producers total 100 percent per policy.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calculation trigger date retained on the policy for cycle traceability.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unlicensed or unappointed producers logged and held from calculation with disposition.
generic.Test population: All commission calculations initiated for the issuance period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No commission calculated at a rate outside the producer agreement schedule.
generic.Exception handling path: Hold the calculation and refer the licence or schedule gap to producer administration.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Producer appointed and licensed with the agreed schedule and rate applied.
generic.Evidence location: Commission platform calculation record and the producer agreement on file.

steps.title: Confirm the producer licence and appointment in the policy state
sop: Open the producer record and read licence and appointment status for the state.
Confirm both are current as at the policy effective date.
Done when licence and appointment are confirmed current.
verify: Re-read the licence and appointment expiry dates.
Pass when both are valid at the policy effective date.

steps.title: Check the commission schedule against the producer agreement
sop: Open the producer agreement for the product and term.
Compare the schedule the platform will apply to the agreement.
Done when the applicable schedule is confirmed.
verify: Recheck the schedule code on the commission record.
Pass when the schedule matches the producer agreement.

steps.title: Verify the new-business rate applies on a first-term policy
sop: Read the policy term sequence on the policy record.
Confirm the new-business rate rather than renewal rate is selected.
Done when the correct rate basis is selected.
verify: Re-read the rate basis on the commission record.
Pass when a first-term policy carries the new-business rate.

steps.title: Confirm split percentages across producers total 100 percent
sop: List producers sharing commission on the policy with their percentages.
Sum the percentages across all listed producers.
Done when the split percentages sum to 100 percent.
verify: Recompute the split total on the policy.
Pass when the total is exactly 100 percent.

steps.title: Initiate the commission calculation in the commission platform
sop: Trigger the calculation for the policy in the billing/commission platform.
Confirm the calculation completes without an error status.
Done when the calculation has been initiated and completed.
verify: Read the calculation status on the commission record.
Pass when the calculation completed without error.

steps.title: Record the trigger date so payment lands in the correct cycle
sop: Record the calculation trigger date on the policy commission record.
Confirm the date falls inside the intended commission cycle.
Done when the trigger date is recorded against the cycle.
verify: Re-read the trigger date and cycle on the record.
Pass when the trigger date sits in the intended cycle.

generic.Defined scope/population: All coverage terms, limits, deductibles and dates on the policy being issued.
generic.In-scope period: The policy term as stated on the bind order.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Limits, sub-limits, deductibles, coinsurance, dates and named insured populated and valid.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Coverage lines validated equals coverage lines on the bound quote.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation record retained on the policy file with the comparison date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Variances logged as exceptions with the underwriter approval reference.
generic.Test population: Every coverage line and date field on the issued policy.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero unexplained variances between issued terms and the bound quote.
generic.Exception handling path: Halt issuance and return the variance to underwriting for approval or correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Limits, deductibles and dates reconciled line by line to the bound quote.
generic.Evidence location: Validation record on the policy file and the bound quote on the workstation.

steps.title: Open the bound quote alongside the policy coverage screen
sop: Retrieve the bound quote from the underwriting workstation.
Open the policy coverage screen in the administration system.
Done when both views are open for the same policy.
verify: Match the quote number to the policy submission reference.
Pass when both records relate to the same submission.

steps.title: Compare each coverage limit line by line
sop: Work down the coverage list comparing each limit to the quote.
Mark any coverage whose limit differs.
Done when every coverage limit has been compared.
verify: Re-read the limits marked as differing.
Pass when no coverage limit differs from the quote.

steps.title: Confirm deductibles, sub-limits and coinsurance match exactly
sop: Compare deductibles, sub-limits and coinsurance percentages to the quote.
Mark any value that differs from the bound quote.
Done when all three attribute sets have been compared.
verify: Re-read the marked values against the quote.
Pass when none of the three attribute sets differs.

steps.title: Check effective date, expiration date and term length
sop: Compare effective and expiration dates to the bind order.
Confirm the resulting term length matches the bound term.
Done when dates and term length are confirmed.
verify: Recompute the term length from the two dates.
Pass when dates and term length agree with the bind order.

steps.title: Verify named insured legal name, entity type and address
sop: Compare named insured legal name and entity type to the application.
Compare the mailing address to the application.
Done when insured identity fields are confirmed.
verify: Re-read the insured fields against the application.
Pass when name, entity type and address all match.

steps.title: Record variances as exceptions with the underwriter approval
sop: Log each variance found as an exception on the policy file.
Attach the underwriter approval reference for each accepted variance.
Done when every variance carries an approval reference.
verify: Re-read the exception log for unapproved variances.
Pass when no variance is left without an approval reference.

generic.Defined scope/population: Requested mid-term changes needing an underwriting eligibility decision.
generic.In-scope period: Changes requested with effective dates inside the current policy term.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Change type, added exposures and requested effective date populated on the transaction.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Eligibility decisions recorded equals endorsement requests routed for assessment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Eligibility decision and rationale retained as a dated file note on the transaction.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Referral-trigger breaches logged with the underwriter referral and outcome.
generic.Test population: All endorsement requests assessed for eligibility in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No ineligible exposure endorsed without a recorded referral approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Refer the change to an underwriter and hold processing until the decision is filed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Decision documented with the appetite or eligibility rule relied on.
generic.Evidence location: Endorsement transaction file note and the underwriting workstation decision record.

steps.title: Open the change request on the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the endorsement request and read the requested change in full.
Identify the coverage parts and exposures affected.
Done when the requested change is understood and scoped.
verify: Compare the scoped change to the request text.
Pass when the scope reflects the request as submitted.

steps.title: Check the change against current appetite and eligibility rules
sop: Open the appetite and eligibility rules for the product.
Test the requested change against each applicable rule.
Done when the change is assessed against all applicable rules.
verify: Re-read the rules cited in the assessment.
Pass when every applicable rule has been assessed.

steps.title: Run added exposures through the eligibility screens
sop: Enter added locations, vehicles, drivers or insureds on the workstation.
Run the eligibility screens over the added exposures.
Done when every added exposure has a screen result.
verify: Read the screen results for each added exposure.
Pass when no added exposure fails an eligibility screen unresolved.

steps.title: Verify no class, territory or no-write restriction is breached
sop: Check the account for class, territory and no-write restrictions.
Confirm the change does not breach any recorded restriction.
Done when restriction checks are complete.
verify: Re-read the restriction flags on the account.
Pass when no restriction is breached by the change.

steps.title: Refer changes that cross a documented referral trigger
sop: Compare the change against the documented referral triggers.
Refer to an underwriter where a trigger is crossed.
Done when triggered changes have been referred.
verify: Check referral records against the triggered change list.
Pass when every triggered change has a referral.

steps.title: Record the eligibility decision and rationale on the transaction
sop: Enter the eligibility decision on the endorsement transaction.
Record the rationale and any referral approval reference.
Done when decision and rationale are recorded.
verify: Re-read the file note on the endorsement transaction.
Pass when the note states decision, rationale and approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: Endorsement change requests whose transaction is bound and documents issued.
generic.In-scope period: Requests completed within the 48-hour endorsement service standard.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Closure code, completion date and elapsed time populated on the change request.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Requests closed equals endorsements bound plus withdrawn and declined requests.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Endorsement documents and closure timestamp retained on the case record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open subtasks such as missing signatures logged with the disposition before closure.
generic.Test population: All endorsement change requests closed in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No request closed while its premium adjustment remains unposted.
generic.Exception handling path: Reopen the request and return it to the servicing queue with the open item named.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Closure code reflects the outcome and the endorsement is issued and billed.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow case management tool request record and the policy billing account.

steps.title: Confirm the endorsement is bound and documents issued
sop: Open the endorsement transaction in the policy administration system.
Confirm the transaction is bound and the documents are issued.
Done when bound status and issued documents are confirmed.
verify: Re-read the endorsement status and document list.
Pass when the endorsement is bound with documents issued.

steps.title: Check the billing adjustment has posted with no suspense item
sop: Open the billing account for the policy.
Confirm the premium adjustment has posted and nothing sits in suspense.
Done when the adjustment is posted and suspense is clear.
verify: Re-read the suspense list for the account.
Pass when no premium item for the endorsement is in suspense.

steps.title: Set the closure code to the endorsement outcome
sop: Open the closure panel on the change request.
Select processed, withdrawn or declined to match the outcome.
Done when a specific outcome code is selected.
verify: Re-read the closure code on the request.
Pass when the code matches the actual outcome.

steps.title: Record elapsed time against the 48-hour endorsement standard
sop: Read the request receipt timestamp and the completion timestamp.
Record the elapsed hours against the service standard.
Done when elapsed time is recorded on the request.
verify: Recompute elapsed hours from the two timestamps.
Pass when the recorded elapsed time matches the computation.

steps.title: Confirm no follow-up subtask remains open on the case
sop: List open subtasks on the endorsement case in the workflow tool.
Resolve or reassign any remaining subtask before closure.
Done when no follow-up subtask remains open.
verify: Re-run the open subtask list for the case.
Pass when the list returns zero open subtasks.

steps.title: Close the change request and confirm the closed status
sop: Submit the closure with the outcome code and completion date.
Confirm the case status changes to Closed.
Done when the request status reads Closed.
verify: Reopen the case record read-only after closure.
Pass when status is Closed with the outcome code retained.

generic.Defined scope/population: Parties requesting policy changes on behalf of the insured or the agency.
generic.In-scope period: Requests received in the current endorsement intake period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Requestor name, relationship and verification method populated on the request.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Verified requestors equals endorsement requests accepted for processing.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Verification method and date retained on the endorsement request record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unverified third-party requests logged and rejected with the disposition recorded.
generic.Test population: All endorsement requests accepted in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No coverage change accepted from an unverified third party.
generic.Exception handling path: Refuse the change and request written authority or a power of attorney.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Requestor matched to the policy contact list or holds documented written authority.
generic.Evidence location: Endorsement request record and the CRM contact verification history.

steps.title: Match the requestor against the policy contact list
sop: Open the policy record and read the named insured and authorised contacts.
Compare the requestor name to that list.
Done when the requestor is matched or identified as external.
verify: Re-read the matched contact entry on the policy.
Pass when the requestor is on the authorised contact list or flagged.

steps.title: Confirm agency requests come from the current agent of record
sop: Read the agent of record on the policy producer record.
Confirm the requesting agency is that agent of record.
Done when agency authority is confirmed or refused.
verify: Re-read the agent of record on the producer record.
Pass when the requesting agency is the agent of record.

steps.title: Complete caller verification before accepting a phone request
sop: Ask the scripted caller verification questions in the CRM.
Record the questions passed against the contact record.
Done when caller verification is completed and recorded.
verify: Re-read the verification result on the CRM contact.
Pass when verification is recorded as passed before acceptance.

steps.title: Check written authority for third-party requestors
sop: Search the policy file for a power of attorney or written authorisation.
Refuse the request where no authority document is on file.
Done when third-party authority is confirmed or the request is refused.
verify: Re-read the authority document on file.
Pass when a valid authority document supports the request.

steps.title: Record requestor name, relationship and verification method
sop: Enter the requestor name and relationship on the endorsement request.
Record the verification method used and the date.
Done when all three details are recorded.
verify: Re-read the requestor section of the request.
Pass when name, relationship and verification method are present.

steps.title: Reject unverified requests and log the disposition
sop: Reject any request where authority cannot be verified.
Log the rejection reason and notify the requestor.
Done when unverified requests are rejected and logged.
verify: Re-check accepted requests for missing verification.
Pass when no accepted request lacks a verification record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Completed endorsements requiring confirmation to the requesting party.
generic.In-scope period: Endorsements completed in the current service period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Endorsement number, effective date and premium adjustment stated in the confirmation.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Confirmations logged equals endorsements completed in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Confirmation logged on the policy contact history with date and channel.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed or bounced confirmations logged with the resend disposition.
generic.Test population: All endorsements completed in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No endorsement completed without a confirmation to the requesting party.
generic.Exception handling path: Resend the confirmation on an alternate channel and log the second attempt.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Confirmation issued on the request channel stating number, date and premium change.
generic.Evidence location: CRM policy contact history and the endorsement transaction record.

steps.title: Identify the channel the endorsement request arrived on
sop: Open the endorsement request and read the intake channel.
Select the same channel for the completion confirmation.
Done when the confirmation channel is selected.
verify: Re-read the intake channel on the request.
Pass when the confirmation channel matches the intake channel.

steps.title: Draft the confirmation stating number, date and premium change
sop: State the endorsement number and effective date in the confirmation.
State the premium adjustment amount and its direction.
Done when all three facts appear in the confirmation.
verify: Re-read the draft confirmation content.
Pass when number, effective date and premium change are all stated.

steps.title: Copy the producer of record on insured-initiated changes
sop: Check whether the request came from the insured directly.
Add the producer of record as a copy recipient where it did.
Done when the producer is copied on insured-initiated changes.
verify: Re-read the recipient list on the confirmation.
Pass when the producer is copied where the insured requested.

steps.title: Send the confirmation to the requestor
sop: Send the confirmation on the selected channel.
Capture the send confirmation or delivery reference.
Done when the confirmation has been sent.
verify: Read the send confirmation reference.
Pass when a send reference exists for the confirmation.

steps.title: Log the confirmation on the policy contact history
sop: Record the confirmation in the CRM policy contact history.
Enter the send date and channel on the log entry.
Done when the confirmation is logged with date and channel.
verify: Re-read the contact history entry.
Pass when the entry records the confirmation date and channel.

steps.title: Close the customer contact only after the send is logged
sop: Confirm the confirmation send is logged against the policy.
Close the customer contact record in the CRM.
Done when the contact is closed after logging.
verify: Check closed contacts for a linked confirmation log entry.
Pass when every closed contact has a logged confirmation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Endorsement declarations and revised forms for despatch to insured and producer.
generic.In-scope period: Endorsements issued in the current despatch cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Delivery preference, recipient addresses and endorsement document set populated.
