generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Despatches logged equals two per endorsement, insured copy and producer copy.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Despatch date and channel retained on the endorsement transaction.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Undeliverable despatches logged with the address correction disposition.
generic.Test population: All endorsements despatched in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No coverage-reducing endorsement delivered without the required notice.
generic.Exception handling path: Recall the despatch, add the missing notice and resend the full package.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Insured and producer copies despatched on the preference channel with date recorded.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText Document Mgmt endorsement folder and the policy delivery log.

steps.title: Assemble the endorsement despatch set from OpenText
sop: Retrieve the endorsement declarations and revised forms from OpenText.
Assemble them into the despatch set for the policy.
Done when the despatch set is assembled.
verify: Compare the set to the endorsement document list.
Pass when every generated endorsement document is in the set.

steps.title: Read the policy delivery preference for the despatch channel
sop: Open the policy record and read the delivery preference.
Select the despatch channel to match the preference.
Done when the despatch channel is selected.
verify: Re-read the preference on the policy record.
Pass when the chosen channel matches the preference.

steps.title: Include the coverage-reduction notice where coverage is removed
sop: Check whether the endorsement reduces or removes coverage.
Add the required notice of coverage reduction to the set.
Done when the notice is included where coverage is reduced.
verify: Re-check reducing endorsements for the notice.
Pass when every coverage-reducing despatch includes the notice.

steps.title: Despatch the insured copy and the producer copy
sop: Despatch the insured copy to the mailing address of record.
Despatch the producer copy to the agency of record address.
Done when both copies have been despatched.
verify: Read the despatch confirmations for both copies.
Pass when both insured and producer despatches are confirmed.

steps.title: Record despatch date and channel on the endorsement transaction
sop: Enter the despatch date and channel on the endorsement transaction.
Note both recipients against the despatch entry.
Done when the despatch is recorded on the transaction.
verify: Re-read the despatch fields on the transaction.
Pass when date, channel and recipients are all recorded.

steps.title: File the delivery confirmation against the endorsement
sop: Save the delivery confirmation to the endorsement folder in OpenText.
Index it to the policy number and endorsement number.
Done when the confirmation is filed and indexed.
verify: Search OpenText by endorsement number for the confirmation.
Pass when the delivery confirmation is retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Approved change requests requiring an endorsement transaction on the in-force term.
generic.In-scope period: Endorsements effective inside the current policy term.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Endorsement form number, effective date and changed fields populated on the transaction.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Endorsement numbers increment in sequence with no gaps on the policy term.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Bound endorsement transaction retained with its form number and bind timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Backdated effective dates logged with the authority approval and disposition.
generic.Test population: All endorsements generated on the policy term in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No endorsement backdated beyond documented authority.
generic.Exception handling path: Refer backdating requests to the authority holder before the transaction is bound.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Transaction bound with the correct form number and agreed effective date.
generic.Evidence location: Endorsement transaction in PolicyCenter and the policy forms schedule.

steps.title: Create the endorsement transaction with the agreed effective date
sop: Start a policy change transaction in PolicyCenter on the in-force term.
Enter the agreed effective date rather than the data-entry date.
Done when the transaction opens with the agreed effective date.
verify: Re-read the transaction effective date.
Pass when it equals the agreed change effective date.

steps.title: Select the endorsement form for the change type
sop: Open the approved forms library filtered to the change type and state.
Select the correct endorsement form number and edition.
Done when the endorsement form is attached to the transaction.
verify: Re-read the selected form number and edition.
Pass when the form matches the change type and state.

steps.title: Enter only the fields being changed
sop: Update only the coverage or exposure fields named in the request.
Confirm unchanged coverages carry forward untouched.
Done when only the requested fields differ from the prior version.
verify: Run the transaction difference view against the prior version.
Pass when only the requested fields show as changed.

steps.title: Confirm the endorsement number increments in sequence
sop: Read the endorsement number assigned on the transaction.
Compare it to the last endorsement number on the term.
Done when the number increments without a gap.
verify: List endorsement numbers on the term in order.
Pass when the sequence has no gap or duplicate.

steps.title: Bind the endorsement transaction
sop: Resolve any validation message and bind the endorsement.
Confirm the transaction status reads Bound.
Done when the endorsement is bound.
verify: Re-read the endorsement transaction status.
Pass when the status is Bound with no open validation.

steps.title: Confirm the in-force record and forms schedule reflect the change
sop: Open the in-force policy view after binding.
Confirm the changed values and the endorsement form both appear.
Done when in-force values and forms schedule show the change.
verify: Re-read the in-force coverage values and the forms schedule.
Pass when both reflect the bound endorsement.

generic.Defined scope/population: Confirmation document set for the bound endorsement on the policy term.
generic.In-scope period: Endorsements bound in the current document generation run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Change description, effective date and premium adjustment merged onto the documents.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documents attached equals documents on the endorsement composition manifest.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Generated set retained on the endorsement transaction with template version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Merge placeholder failures logged with the regeneration disposition.
generic.Test population: All endorsement confirmation documents generated in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero documents generated from a superseded template version.
generic.Exception handling path: Correct the template selection and regenerate rather than editing the PDF.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Amended declarations and endorsement form generated and attached to the transaction.
generic.Evidence location: Endorsement document list in the administration system and OpenText.

steps.title: Generate the amended declarations from the bound endorsement
sop: Run document generation from the bound endorsement transaction.
Confirm the amended declarations show post-change limits and premium.
Done when the amended declarations are generated.
verify: Read limits and premium on the amended declarations.
Pass when both reflect the post-change values.

steps.title: Confirm the endorsement document states change, date and premium
sop: Open the generated endorsement form.
Confirm it names the change, effective date and premium adjustment.
Done when all three appear on the face of the document.
verify: Re-read the three statements on the endorsement form.
Pass when change, date and premium adjustment are all stated.

steps.title: Check the revised forms schedule lists added and removed forms
sop: Open the revised forms schedule on the generated set.
Confirm forms added or removed by the endorsement are shown.
Done when the schedule reflects the form changes.
verify: Compare the schedule to the endorsement form changes.
Pass when added and removed forms are both reflected.

steps.title: Confirm the template version used is current
sop: Read the template version recorded on the generation run.
Compare it to the current approved template version.
Done when the run used the current template version.
verify: Re-read the template version on the run log.
Pass when no superseded template version was used.

steps.title: Scan the generated PDFs for unresolved merge placeholders
sop: Search the generated documents for placeholder markers.
Flag any document containing a placeholder for regeneration.
Done when no document contains an unresolved placeholder.
verify: Repeat the placeholder scan on the final set.
Pass when the scan returns zero placeholders.

steps.title: Attach the generated set to the endorsement transaction
sop: Attach the generated documents to the endorsement transaction.
Confirm they appear in the policy document list.
Done when the set is attached and listed.
verify: Open the endorsement document list.
Pass when every generated document is attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: Endorsement requests arriving by email, portal or signed change form.
generic.In-scope period: Requests received in the current intake day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, change type code, requested effective date and source attachment populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Work items created equals requests received across all intake channels.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Source request attached to the work item with its receipt timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests without a source document logged and returned to the requestor.
generic.Test population: All endorsement requests logged in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No endorsement worked without a logged source request on file.
generic.Exception handling path: Hold the request and ask the requestor for the written change instruction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Work item created with change type, requested effective date and source attached.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow case management tool work item with its attachments and CRM contact.

steps.title: Create the endorsement work item against the correct policy term
sop: Search the policy number in the administration system and confirm the current term.
Create the endorsement work item against that term in the case tool.
Done when the work item exists on the correct policy term.
verify: Re-read the policy and term on the work item.
Pass when both match the policy identified in the request.

steps.title: Record the requested change in the requestor own words
sop: Copy the requested change text verbatim onto the work item.
Add the structured change type code alongside it.
Done when both the verbatim text and the code are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded text to the source request.
Pass when the text matches and a change type code is set.

steps.title: Capture the requested effective date and flag retroactive dates
sop: Enter the requested effective date on the work item.
Flag the request where the date is earlier than today.
Done when the date is captured and retroactivity flagged.
verify: Re-read the effective date and retroactive flag.
Pass when retroactive requests carry the flag.

steps.title: Attach the source request to the work item
sop: Attach the email, portal submission or signed change form.
Confirm the attachment opens and is legible.
Done when the source request is attached and readable.
verify: Open the attachment from the work item.
Pass when a legible source request is attached.

steps.title: Acknowledge receipt to the requestor and start the SLA clock
sop: Send the acknowledgment to the requestor from the CRM.
Start the endorsement SLA clock on the work item.
Done when acknowledgment is sent and the SLA clock started.
verify: Read the acknowledgment log and SLA start timestamp.
Pass when both are recorded on the work item.

steps.title: Reconcile work items created to requests received
sop: Count requests received across email, portal and paper for the day.
Compare that count to work items created in the case tool.
Done when the two counts have been compared.
verify: Investigate any difference between the counts.
Pass when created work items equal requests received.

generic.Defined scope/population: Endorsement transactions requiring an audit entry on the policy history.
generic.In-scope period: Changes processed in the current endorsement period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Requestor, verification method, approving authority and premium impact populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Audit entries recorded equals endorsement transactions bound in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Immutable audit row retained with the processing user and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Entries missing an approving authority logged and corrected before period close.
generic.Test population: All endorsement audit entries written in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No endorsement history entry lacking an identified approving authority.
generic.Exception handling path: Raise a data incident and reconstruct the missing attribution from the case record.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Entry shows requestor, authority and premium impact with pre and post values retrievable.
generic.Evidence location: Policy history in the administration system and the workflow case record.

steps.title: Open the endorsement audit entry on the policy history
sop: Open the policy history after the endorsement binds.
Locate the audit row for the endorsement transaction.
Done when the audit row is visible in history.
verify: Match the row to the endorsement number.
Pass when the row corresponds to the bound endorsement.

steps.title: Confirm the entry names the requestor and verification method
sop: Read the requestor name recorded on the entry.
Confirm the verification method used is recorded alongside.
Done when requestor and verification method are both present.
verify: Compare the entry to the request record in the case tool.
Pass when both fields match the request record.

steps.title: Check the approving authority level is recorded
sop: Read the approving authority level on the audit entry.
Compare it to the authority matrix requirement for the change type.
Done when the recorded authority is confirmed sufficient.
verify: Re-read the authority level against the matrix row.
Pass when the recorded authority meets the matrix requirement.

steps.title: Verify the premium impact is captured as an amount
sop: Read the premium impact recorded on the entry.
Confirm it shows an increase, return or nil amount.
Done when the premium impact amount is recorded.
verify: Compare the amount to the rated endorsement adjustment.
Pass when the entry amount equals the rated adjustment.

steps.title: Confirm pre-change and post-change values are retrievable
sop: Open the prior policy version and the endorsed version from history.
Confirm both sets of coverage values can be retrieved.
Done when both versions are retrievable from history.
verify: Retrieve both versions again from the history screen.
Pass when pre-change and post-change values both display.

steps.title: Check the entry is timestamped and not editable
sop: Read the processing user and timestamp on the entry.
Confirm no edit or delete control is available on the entry.
Done when the entry is confirmed immutable and timestamped.
verify: Attempt to edit the entry from the history screen.
Pass when no edit path exists and the timestamp is present.

generic.Defined scope/population: Material coverage changes requiring notification to claims, reinsurance and reporting.
generic.In-scope period: Endorsements bound since the previous downstream interface run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, revised limits, effective date and change type present on each message.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Messages acknowledged equals messages sent for the endorsement batch.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notification confirmation references retained on the endorsement transaction.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected downstream messages logged with the reprocessing disposition.
generic.Test population: All coverage-change notifications sent in the interface run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No material coverage change left unpropagated on the interface error queue.
generic.Exception handling path: Reprocess the failed message and escalate if it fails a second run.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claims and reinsurance interfaces acknowledge the endorsement notification.
generic.Evidence location: Interface monitor log and the endorsement transaction notification references.

steps.title: Confirm the coverage-change extract fired to claims
sop: Open the interface monitor and filter on the policy and endorsement.
Confirm the claims message was generated and sent.
Done when the claims message shows as sent.
verify: Read the claims message status on the monitor.
Pass when the claims message is sent and acknowledged.

steps.title: Check the reinsurance cession picked up the revised limit
sop: Open the reinsurance cession record for the policy.
Confirm the revised limit is reflected where a treaty threshold is crossed.
Done when the cession reflects the endorsed limit.
verify: Compare the cession limit to the endorsed policy limit.
Pass when the cession carries the revised limit.

steps.title: Verify statistical and regulatory reporting captured the endorsement
sop: Open the statistical extract for the reporting period.
Confirm the endorsement appears in the correct period.
Done when the endorsement is present in the extract.
verify: Search the extract for the endorsement transaction.
Pass when the endorsement appears in the correct period.

steps.title: Review the interface error queue for rejected messages
sop: Filter the interface error queue on the policy number.
List any rejected downstream message with its reason.
Done when the error queue has been reviewed for the policy.
verify: Re-run the error queue filter.
Pass when no message for the policy remains in error.

steps.title: Reprocess rejected downstream messages
sop: Correct the underlying data for each rejected message.
Resubmit the message on the next interface run.
Done when every rejected message has been resubmitted.
verify: Read the status of resubmitted messages after the run.
Pass when all resubmitted messages are acknowledged.

steps.title: Record notification references on the endorsement transaction
sop: Collect the confirmation references from each downstream consumer.
Record them on the endorsement transaction.
Done when all references are recorded.
verify: Re-read the notification references on the transaction.
Pass when a reference exists for each downstream consumer.

generic.Defined scope/population: Bound-in-principle endorsements requiring a pro-rata premium adjustment.
generic.In-scope period: Days remaining in the term from the endorsement effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Endorsement effective date, rate book version and changed exposures populated for rating.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: System pro-rata adjustment agrees with the manual pro-rata recalculation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rating result and rate book version retained on the endorsement transaction.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rating variances logged with the investigation outcome before binding.
generic.Test population: All endorsements rated in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No endorsement rated on a rate book other than the one in force at policy inception.
generic.Exception handling path: Re-run rating on the correct rate book and void the incorrect calculation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Pro-rata adjustment computed from the effective date with fees pro-rated alongside.
generic.Evidence location: Rating result on the endorsement transaction and the underwriting workstation worksheet.

steps.title: Confirm the rate book in force at the policy effective date
sop: Read the rate book version applied at policy inception.
Select that version for the endorsement rating run.
Done when the correct rate book is selected.
verify: Re-read the rate book version on the rating run.
Pass when it equals the version in force at inception.

steps.title: Run the endorsement through the rating engine
sop: Submit the endorsement to the rating engine from the transaction.
Confirm the run completes without a rating error.
Done when the rating run returns a premium result.
verify: Read the rating run status and result.
Pass when the run completed and returned a premium.

steps.title: Confirm the pro-rata factor uses days remaining in the term
sop: Read the pro-rata factor and the day count used.
Confirm the count runs from the endorsement effective date to expiry.
Done when the day count matches the remaining term.
verify: Recompute the remaining days from the effective date.
Pass when the day count equals the recomputed figure.

steps.title: Check the adjustment direction is additional or return premium
sop: Read the adjustment sign returned by the rating engine.
Confirm it is consistent with the coverage change made.
Done when the direction is confirmed consistent.
verify: Compare the direction to the nature of the change.
Pass when an increase in cover yields additional premium.

steps.title: Verify taxes, fees and surcharges are pro-rated alongside
sop: Read the tax, fee and surcharge lines on the rating result.
Confirm each is pro-rated on the same basis as base premium.
Done when all charge lines are pro-rated consistently.
verify: Recheck the charge lines against the pro-rata factor.
Pass when every charge line uses the same factor.

steps.title: Compare the calculated adjustment to a manual pro-rata check
sop: Compute the pro-rata adjustment manually on the workstation.
Compare it to the rating engine result.
Done when the two figures have been compared.
verify: Investigate any difference beyond rounding.
Pass when the two figures agree within rounding tolerance.

generic.Defined scope/population: Endorsement requests requiring an authority routing decision before processing.
generic.In-scope period: Requests routed within the referral SLA for the current period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Change type, premium impact and authority matrix row populated on the work item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Routed items equals requests requiring routing for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Routing decision and matrix row retained on the work item with the routing timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items not acknowledged within the referral SLA logged and escalated.
generic.Test population: All endorsement requests routed in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No change processed at an authority level below the matrix requirement.
generic.Exception handling path: Recall the item and re-route to the correct authority level before processing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Routing decision records the required authority level and the matrix row relied on.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow case management tool routing history and the authority matrix.

steps.title: Read the change type and premium impact on the request
sop: Open the endorsement work item and read the change type code.
Read the estimated premium impact for the change.
Done when both attributes are known.
verify: Compare the attributes to the request content.
Pass when change type and premium impact reflect the request.

steps.title: Look up the required authority level in the authority matrix
sop: Open the authority matrix on the underwriting workstation.
Find the row matching the change type and premium impact.
Done when the required authority level is identified.
verify: Re-read the matched matrix row.
Pass when the row matches the change type and impact.

steps.title: Route administrative changes to service processing
sop: Identify non-material administrative changes on the request.
Route those items to the service processing queue.
Done when administrative changes are routed to service.
verify: Read the destination queue on the work item.
Pass when administrative changes sit in the service queue.

steps.title: Route coverage changes to underwriting
sop: Identify coverage-affecting changes on the request.
Route those items to the underwriting queue.
Done when coverage changes are routed to underwriting.
verify: Read the destination queue for coverage changes.
Pass when coverage changes sit in the underwriting queue.

steps.title: Escalate changes exceeding the servicing threshold
sop: Compare the premium impact to the servicing threshold.
Escalate to the next authority level where the threshold is exceeded.
Done when over-threshold items are escalated.
verify: Re-check over-threshold items for an escalation record.
Pass when every over-threshold item is escalated.

steps.title: Record the routing decision and confirm queue acknowledgment
sop: Record the routing decision and matrix row on the work item.
Confirm the receiving queue acknowledged within the referral SLA.
Done when decision is recorded and acknowledgment received.
verify: Read the acknowledgment timestamp on the routed item.
Pass when acknowledgment falls inside the referral SLA.

generic.Defined scope/population: Billing accounts affected by a bound endorsement premium adjustment.
generic.In-scope period: Instalments remaining from the endorsement effective date to expiry.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Adjustment amount, effective date, pay plan and instalment schedule populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Re-spread instalments sum to the revised premium plus charges due.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Posting reference and posting date retained on the billing account.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Suspense items created by the posting logged with the clearance disposition.
generic.Test population: All endorsement premium adjustments posted in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No premium adjustment left unapplied in billing suspense.
generic.Exception handling path: Clear the suspense item and repost the adjustment against the correct term.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Adjustment posted at the endorsement effective date with the schedule re-spread.
generic.Evidence location: Guidewire BillingCenter account transactions and the instalment schedule.

steps.title: Post the premium adjustment to the billing account
sop: Open the billing account in Guidewire BillingCenter.
Post the endorsement adjustment with the endorsement effective date.
Done when the adjustment appears on the account transactions.
verify: Read the posted transaction date and amount.
Pass when both match the endorsement adjustment.

steps.title: Confirm the instalment schedule re-spreads across remaining instalments
sop: Open the instalment schedule after posting.
Confirm the adjustment is spread per the pay plan rules.
Done when the schedule shows the re-spread instalments.
verify: Total the revised instalments on the schedule.
Pass when the total equals the revised premium due.

steps.title: Apply return premium as credit or refund per the account election
sop: Read the account election for handling return premium.
Apply the return as either a credit or a refund, not both.
Done when the return premium is applied once per the election.
verify: Re-read the account for duplicate return postings.
Pass when the return appears once and matches the election.

steps.title: Verify the revised amount due and next due date
sop: Open the billing summary screen after the re-spread.
Read the revised amount due and next due date.
Done when both values are confirmed against the schedule.
verify: Compare summary values to the instalment schedule.
Pass when amount due and next due date agree.

steps.title: Confirm no orphan suspense item remains from the posting
sop: Open the suspense list for the billing account.
Clear or reassign any item created by the adjustment posting.
Done when no orphan suspense item remains.
verify: Re-run the suspense list for the account.
Pass when the list returns no item from this posting.

steps.title: Record the billing update reference on the endorsement transaction
sop: Copy the billing posting reference from BillingCenter.
Record it on the endorsement transaction for reconciliation.
Done when the reference is recorded on the transaction.
verify: Re-read the reference on the endorsement transaction.
Pass when the reference resolves to the billing posting.

generic.Defined scope/population: In-force policy records affected by a bound endorsement on the current term.
generic.In-scope period: From the endorsement effective date to policy expiry.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Coverage values, version number, forms schedule and exposure schedules populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: In-force premium equals pre-change premium plus the endorsement adjustment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Prior policy version retained in history alongside the incremented version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Version or exposure mismatches logged with the correction disposition.
generic.Test population: All in-force records updated by endorsement in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No prior policy version overwritten or removed from history.
generic.Exception handling path: Roll back the endorsement and reprocess where history integrity is broken.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: In-force record shows endorsed values with an incremented version number.
generic.Evidence location: In-force policy view in PolicyCenter and the policy version history.

steps.title: Commit the endorsement so the in-force view updates
sop: Commit the bound endorsement transaction in PolicyCenter.
Open the in-force policy view for the term.
Done when the in-force view shows the new coverage values.
verify: Compare in-force values to the endorsement transaction.
Pass when the in-force view matches the endorsed values.

steps.title: Confirm the policy version number incremented
sop: Read the policy version number on the in-force record.
Compare it to the version before the endorsement.
Done when the version has incremented by one.
verify: Re-read the version sequence on the term.
Pass when the version incremented without a gap.

steps.title: Check the prior version is retained in history
sop: Open the policy version history for the term.
Retrieve the pre-endorsement version.
Done when the prior version is retrievable.
verify: Open the prior version and read its coverage values.
Pass when the prior version displays its original values.

steps.title: Confirm the forms schedule includes the endorsement form
sop: Open the forms schedule on the in-force record.
Confirm the endorsement form number is listed.
Done when the endorsement form appears on the schedule.
verify: Re-read the forms schedule for the endorsement form.
Pass when the endorsement form is present.

steps.title: Verify exposure schedules reflect additions and deletions
sop: Open the location, vehicle or lives schedules on the policy.
Confirm added items are present and deleted items removed.
Done when exposure schedules match the endorsement.
verify: Compare schedule counts before and after the endorsement.
Pass when the counts move as the endorsement requires.

steps.title: Reconcile in-force premium to the pre-change premium plus adjustment
sop: Read the in-force premium on the policy summary.
Compare it to pre-change premium plus the rated adjustment.
Done when the two figures have been compared.
verify: Recompute the expected in-force premium.
Pass when the summary premium equals the expected figure.

generic.Defined scope/population: Endorsement requests awaiting validation against the in-force policy record.
generic.In-scope period: Requested effective dates inside the current policy term.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Affected coverage part, requested effective date and required authority recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Validated requests equals requests accepted into the endorsement queue.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation note retained on the request with the validation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests contradicting policy data logged and returned to the requestor.
generic.Test population: All endorsement requests validated in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No endorsement processed with an effective date outside the policy term.
generic.Exception handling path: Return the request to the requestor for clarification rather than assuming intent.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validation note records affected coverage, effective date and required authority.
generic.Evidence location: Endorsement request validation note and the policy record in the administration system.

steps.title: Open the policy and confirm it is in force at the requested date
sop: Open the policy record and read status and term dates.
Confirm the policy is not cancelled, lapsed or expired at that date.
Done when in-force status at the requested date is confirmed.
verify: Re-read status and term dates on the policy.
Pass when the policy is in force at the requested effective date.

steps.title: Identify the coverage part or schedule the change touches
sop: Map the requested change to a coverage part or exposure schedule.
Note the affected area on the request record.
Done when the affected coverage area is recorded.
verify: Re-read the noted coverage area against the request.
Pass when the recorded area matches the requested change.

steps.title: Check the requested effective date falls inside the term
sop: Compare the requested effective date to the term dates.
Reject or refer dates falling outside the term.
Done when the date is confirmed inside the term or referred.
verify: Re-read the requested date against the term dates.
Pass when accepted requests sit inside the policy term.

steps.title: Determine the binding authority required for the change
sop: Read the change type and estimated premium impact.
Determine the required authority level from those attributes.
Done when the required authority level is recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded authority to the change attributes.
Pass when the authority level matches the change profile.

steps.title: Return contradicted requests to the requestor
sop: Identify requests contradicted by the policy record.
Return each to the requestor with the contradiction stated.
Done when contradicted requests are returned.
verify: Re-check the active queue for contradicted requests.
Pass when no contradicted request remains in processing.

steps.title: Record the validation outcome on the request
sop: Write the validation note covering coverage, date and authority.
Attach it to the endorsement request record.
Done when the validation note is attached.
verify: Re-read the validation note on the request.
Pass when the note states all three validated attributes.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policies in the renewal window requiring renewal rating for the new term.
generic.In-scope period: The renewal term rated on the rate book effective at the renewal date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rate book version, tier factors, exposures and expiring premium populated for rating.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Renewal premium reconciles to the rating engine output for every coverage.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rate change percentage and rate book version retained on the renewal file.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rate changes over the notice threshold logged and referred to underwriting.
generic.Test population: All renewals rated in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No renewal rated on the expiring rate book after a revision took effect.
generic.Exception handling path: Re-rate on the correct rate book and void the superseded rating result.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Renewal premium rated on the filed rate book effective at the renewal date.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal rating result on the policy file and the underwriting workstation worksheet.

steps.title: Select the rate book effective at the renewal date
sop: Identify the rate book filed and effective for the renewal effective date.
Select that version for the renewal rating run.
Done when the correct rate book is selected.
verify: Re-read the rate book version and its effective date.
Pass when the version is effective at the renewal date.

steps.title: Run renewal rating in the policy administration system
sop: Submit the renewal term to the rating engine.
Confirm the run completes without rating errors.
Done when a renewal premium result is returned.
verify: Read the rating run status and premium result.
Pass when the run completed and returned a premium.

steps.title: Confirm carrier rate revisions flowed through
sop: Compare the renewal rate factor to the expiring term factor.
Confirm the revision is reflected in the renewal factor.
Done when the revision impact is confirmed.
verify: Re-read the two rate factors side by side.
Pass when the renewal factor reflects the filed revision.

steps.title: Check tier and experience re-evaluation applied
sop: Read the product rules for tier or experience re-evaluation at renewal.
Confirm the re-evaluation ran where the rules require it.
Done when re-evaluation status is confirmed.
verify: Re-read the tier or mod values on the renewal rating.
Pass when re-evaluated values are present where required.

steps.title: Record the rate change percentage against expiring premium
sop: Compare renewal premium to expiring premium.
Record the rate change percentage on the renewal file.
Done when the percentage is recorded.
verify: Recompute the percentage from the two premiums.
Pass when the recorded percentage matches the computation.

steps.title: Refer renewals exceeding the notice threshold to underwriting
sop: Compare the rate change percentage to the notice threshold.
Refer over-threshold renewals to underwriting before the offer.
Done when over-threshold renewals are referred.
verify: Check offers released against the referral list.
Pass when no over-threshold renewal was offered without referral.

generic.Defined scope/population: Renewals requiring an underwriting review and retention decision before offer.
generic.In-scope period: Renewals reviewed inside the renewal notice window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss history, exposure updates, underwriting action and reviewer name populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reviews filed equals renewals in the review queue for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Renewal review note retained with the reviewing underwriter name and date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Retention concessions logged with the approval and the disposition.
generic.Test population: All renewals reviewed in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No renewal issued with conditions absent from the renewal terms.
generic.Exception handling path: Return the renewal to review and reissue terms carrying the missing condition.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Review note filed with the underwriting action and the reviewer identified.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal review note on the underwriting workstation and the policy renewal file.

steps.title: Open the renewal review screen and refresh the data
sop: Open the renewal review screen on the underwriting workstation.
Confirm loss history and exposure updates have been refreshed.
Done when refreshed data is displayed for review.
verify: Read the data as-of date on the review screen.
Pass when the as-of date is inside the review window.

steps.title: Apply the recorded underwriting action to the renewal
sop: Read the decision of renew as is, with conditions, refer or non-renew.
Apply that action to the renewal transaction.
Done when the action is applied on the renewal.
verify: Re-read the action recorded on the renewal.
Pass when the applied action matches the review decision.

steps.title: Attach renewal conditions to the renewal terms
sop: List conditions such as inspection, deductible increase or exclusion.
Attach each condition to the renewal terms in the policy system.
Done when every condition is attached to the terms.
verify: Compare the terms conditions to the review note.
Pass when no reviewed condition is missing from the terms.

steps.title: Record retention actions on at-risk accounts
sop: Identify at-risk accounts flagged during review.
Record the retention action taken with its approval reference.
Done when retention actions are recorded with approvals.
verify: Re-read the retention action and approval on the file.
Pass when each concession carries an approval reference.

steps.title: File the completed renewal review note
sop: Complete the review note with the action and rationale.
File it against the renewal with the reviewer name and date.
Done when the review note is filed.
verify: Re-read the filed note for reviewer name and date.
Pass when both are present on the note.

steps.title: Reconcile reviews filed to renewals in the review queue
sop: Count renewals in the review queue for the period.
Compare that count to review notes filed.
Done when the two counts have been compared.
verify: Investigate any renewal without a filed review note.
Pass when every queued renewal has a filed review.

generic.Defined scope/population: Expiring-term declarations, forms and correspondence for renewed policies.
generic.In-scope period: Documents belonging to the expiring policy term.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, term dates and document type populated on each archived record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documents archived equals prior-term documents listed on the policy.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archived documents retained with their own term dates and archive timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Documents failing archive logged with the retry disposition.
generic.Test population: All prior-term documents processed in the archive run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No prior-term document deleted ahead of its retention expiry.
generic.Exception handling path: Restore any prematurely removed document and correct its retention class.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Prior-term documents present in the archive store and retrievable by policy and term.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText Document Mgmt archive store and the policy document list.

steps.title: List the expiring-term documents on the policy
sop: Open the policy document list filtered to the expiring term.
Export the list as the archive control total.
Done when the expiring-term document list is captured.
verify: Compare the list term dates to the expiring term.
Pass when only expiring-term documents are listed.

steps.title: Move the documents to the archive store in OpenText
sop: Run the archive move for the listed expiring-term documents.
Confirm the move completes without errors.
Done when the documents reside in the archive store.
verify: Search the archive store for the moved documents.
Pass when every listed document is found in the archive.

steps.title: Confirm archived documents remain indexed to policy and term
sop: Open a sample of archived documents and read their index values.
Confirm policy number and term dates are retained.
Done when index values are confirmed on the sample.
verify: Search the archive by policy number and term.
Pass when the search returns the archived documents.

steps.title: Apply the statutory retention class for the expiring term
sop: Set the retention class for the expiring term rather than active policy.
Confirm the destruction date meets the statutory period.
Done when the retention class is applied.
verify: Re-read the retention class and destruction date.
Pass when retention meets the statutory minimum.

steps.title: Check archived documents are retrievable within the SLA
sop: Request retrieval of a sampled archived document.
Time the retrieval against the retrieval SLA.
Done when the sample retrieval completes.
verify: Compare the retrieval time to the SLA.
Pass when retrieval completes inside the SLA.

steps.title: Confirm no prior-term document remains live on the new term
sop: Open the new-term document list.
Remove or reindex any prior-term document showing as live.
Done when the new-term list holds only new-term documents.
verify: Re-read the new-term document list.
Pass when no prior-term document appears as live.

generic.Defined scope/population: Accepted renewals ready to bind for the new policy term.
generic.In-scope period: Renewal terms effective at the expiring term expiration date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Renewal acceptance, premium, limits, subjectivities and binding user populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Renewal terms bound equals renewal acceptances recorded for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Bind transaction retained with the binding user and bind timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open subjectivities logged as dated open items with the clearing disposition.
generic.Test population: All renewals bound in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No renewal bound by a user outside the binding authority matrix.
generic.Exception handling path: Void the bind and re-bind under a user holding the required authority.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Renewal term bound and chained to the expiring term in policy history.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal transaction in PolicyCenter and the policy term history chain.

steps.title: Confirm the renewal acceptance is on file
sop: Open the renewal file and read the recorded acceptance.
Confirm the acceptance evidence is attached.
Done when acceptance is confirmed on file.
verify: Re-read the acceptance record and its attachment.
Pass when a dated acceptance is on file.

steps.title: Check the binding user authority against the matrix
sop: Read the renewal premium and limits to be bound.
Confirm the binding user authority covers both.
Done when binding authority is confirmed.
verify: Re-read the matrix row for the binding user.
Pass when the bind falls inside that user authority.

steps.title: Run the bind job on the renewal term
sop: Run the bind job in PolicyCenter on the renewal transaction.
Confirm the new term is created with the renewal effective date.
Done when the renewal term is bound.
verify: Read the renewal term status and effective date.
Pass when the term is bound with the correct effective date.

steps.title: Record open renewal subjectivities with due dates
sop: List renewal subjectivities not yet cleared.
Create a dated open item for each on the policy.
Done when every open subjectivity has a dated item.
verify: Compare open items to the subjectivity list.
Pass when each subjectivity has a matching open item.

steps.title: Confirm the renewal term chains to the expiring term
sop: Open the policy term history chain.
Confirm the renewal term links to the expiring term.
Done when the chain link is confirmed.
verify: Navigate from the renewal term back to the expiring term.
Pass when the navigation resolves the expiring term.

steps.title: Reconcile renewals bound to acceptances recorded
sop: Count renewal acceptances recorded for the period.
Compare that count to renewal terms bound.
Done when the counts have been compared.
verify: Investigate any acceptance without a bound term.
Pass when every acceptance has a bound renewal term.

generic.Defined scope/population: Renewal work items whose renewal outcome has been fully processed.
generic.In-scope period: Renewals completed against the current renewal notice-period milestone.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Closure code, completion date and attached renewal declarations populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Work items closed equals renewals concluded in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Renewal declarations attached to the work item with the closure timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open subtasks such as pending broker response logged with the disposition.
generic.Test population: All renewal work items closed in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No renewal work item closed while the renewal remains unbound.
generic.Exception handling path: Reopen the item and return it to the renewal queue with the open task named.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Closure code reflects the outcome with renewal documents attached.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow case management tool renewal work item and its attachments.

steps.title: Confirm the renewal is bound with documents issued
sop: Open the renewal transaction in the policy administration system.
Confirm bound status and issued renewal documents.
Done when bind and document issue are confirmed.
verify: Re-read the renewal status and document list.
Pass when the renewal is bound with documents issued.

steps.title: Confirm billing has transitioned to the renewal term
sop: Open the billing account and read the active schedule term.
Confirm the renewal-term schedule is in place.
Done when billing shows the renewal-term schedule.
verify: Re-read the active billing schedule term.
Pass when the schedule belongs to the renewal term.

steps.title: Set the closure code to the renewal outcome
sop: Open the closure panel on the renewal work item.
Select renewed, non-renewed, lapsed or cancelled at renewal.
Done when a specific outcome code is selected.
verify: Re-read the closure code on the work item.
Pass when the code matches the actual outcome.

steps.title: Record the completion date against the notice-period milestone
sop: Read the notice-period milestone date on the work item.
Record the completion date against that milestone.
Done when the completion date is recorded.
verify: Compare the completion date to the milestone.
Pass when the completion date is recorded and comparable.

steps.title: Confirm no open subtask remains on the renewal case
sop: List open subtasks on the renewal case.
Resolve or reassign any remaining subtask.
Done when no open subtask remains.
verify: Re-run the open subtask list.
Pass when the list returns zero open subtasks.

steps.title: Attach the renewal declarations as the closing artefact
sop: Retrieve the renewal declarations from the policy record.
Attach them to the work item and close the item.
Done when the declarations are attached and the item closed.
verify: Open the closed work item attachment list.
Pass when the renewal declarations are attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: Renewed policies whose new term has passed its renewal effective date.
generic.In-scope period: The first days of the renewal term after the effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Status, term dates, limits, deductibles, forms and producer code populated for the new term.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Policies confirmed in force equals renewals bound with effective dates passed.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: In-force confirmation recorded on the renewal work item with the check date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Coverage gaps logged as incidents with the correction disposition.
generic.Test population: All renewal terms reaching their effective date in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero days of coverage gap between expiring and renewal terms.
generic.Exception handling path: Raise a coverage-gap incident and correct the term dates under authority.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: New period shows In Force with dates continuous from the expiring term.
generic.Evidence location: PolicyCenter policy summary and the in-force listing for the new term.

steps.title: Open the policy after the renewal effective date
sop: Open the policy in PolicyCenter on the day after the effective date.
Read the status for the new term.
Done when the new-term status has been read.
verify: Re-read the status field for the renewal term.
Pass when the status is In Force.

steps.title: Check for a coverage gap between the two terms
sop: Compare the expiring expiration date to the renewal effective date.
Confirm the dates are continuous with no gap day.
Done when continuity is confirmed.
verify: Recompute the day difference between the two dates.
Pass when the difference leaves no uncovered day.

steps.title: Verify limits, deductibles and forms match the accepted offer
sop: Open the renewal offer accepted by the insured.
Compare limits, deductibles and forms to the in-force term.
Done when all three have been compared.
verify: Re-read any item marked as differing.
Pass when no item differs from the accepted offer.

steps.title: Confirm the policy appears on the in-force listing for the new term
sop: Run the in-force listing for the renewal term.
Confirm the policy appears under the correct producer code.
Done when the policy is visible on the listing.
verify: Re-read the producer code on the listing row.
Pass when the producer code matches the policy record.

steps.title: Record the in-force confirmation on the renewal work item
sop: Record the confirmation result and the check date on the work item.
Attach the listing evidence to the item.
Done when the confirmation is recorded with evidence.
verify: Re-read the confirmation entry on the work item.
Pass when result, date and evidence are all present.

steps.title: Escalate any renewal not showing in force
sop: List renewals past effective date not showing In Force.
Escalate each for immediate correction.
Done when every exception has been escalated.
verify: Re-run the exception list after escalation.
Pass when no renewal past effective date is left unresolved.
